title: Interior Department: Migratory Bird Hunting; Seasons and Bag and Possession Limits for Certain Migratory Game Birds
summary: This rule prescribes the hunting seasons, hours, areas, and daily bag and possession limits for migratory game birds. Taking of migratory birds is prohibited unless specifically provided for by annual regulations. This rule permits the taking of designated species during the 2017-18 season.
